acceptance_1_diagnosis.decision: the container-level values are the union over the run (hosts), the FinMind token only when a FinMind profile is in the run, the largest max records, and the run's symbol set; per-profile values stay per call.

scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh: bounded_runtime_* helpers: per-run state directory (mode 0700/0600) recorded before the first mutation with the steady pre-environment, image id, stopped steady container ids, steady controller mode, lease seconds and deploy values; restore from that record; memory.peak / limit / OOM capture; market-open guard; profile validation against the run union

execute_bounded_source_refresh_entrypoint: in a run the first profile that needs a refresh enters the bounded runtime once, later profiles reuse it and only start and remove their own one-shot containers; a signal or failure ends only that profile (one-shots removed, created leftovers removed, container counts checked, failed outcome written)

execute_steady_posture_check: restores the run's bounded runtime once from the record (never from the contaminated bounded container environment, so the egress union and the FinMind token are removed), waits for health start periods, reads only its own outcome, reports bounded_runtime enter and restore recreates and memory
preflight snapshot and readback reads wait (12 attempts x 10 s call, 5 s pause) for a warming-up source-ingest instead of failing on one 3 s call
steady_check_find_refresh_orphans ignores the calling call's own children (call id), so the next profile can wait for or stop a left-over process of the run
plan step (scripts/tw_refresh_outcome_summary.py --plan) gives the egress union, FinMind flag and max records; every refresh step passes them; the steady check step keeps the bounded_runtime summary in the outcome artifact; no step other than the steady check restores
change.scripts/tw_refresh_outcome_summary.py: PROFILE_HOSTS table, plan_run(), --plan; not_run is a failing connector status

acceptance_2_recreates.design: at most 2: one recreate into the bounded runtime by the first profile call that needs a refresh, one restore by the steady check

acceptance_2_recreates.hosted_count: pending: the release owner reads the next hosted refresh run by its run id; count Recreate/Recreated lines of pantheon-source-ingest-1 in the job log or docker events (expected 2).

acceptance_4_guarantees: lease acquire, heartbeat, re-arm and release steps unchanged (the lease is held from before the first recreate until after the steady check); the steady check still waits for or stops a left-over process, waits for health start periods, removes created leftovers and checks container counts, and only reads its own call outcome; interrupt tests: test_interrupt_at_any_profile_leaves_one_restore_for_the_steady_check (profiles 0, 1, 6, 11 x TERM, HUP), test_interrupt_while_entering_is_retried_by_the_next_profile_and_still_restored_once
acceptance_5_no_overlap: every run-mode profile call first settles left-over refresh processes of the run (wait STEADY_CHECK_ORPHAN_WAIT_SECONDS, default 180, then TERM, grace 60, then KILL) and records previous_profile_process {action ended|stopped, pids, seconds} in its outcome; the loops keep going after a failed profile and every outcome file is listed by the summary step
acceptance_6_market_open: bounded_runtime_market_open_guard: on Mon-Fri UTC a profile does not start from 00:35Z (00:55Z minus a 900 s profile budget and a 300 s restore budget) until the 05:30Z close; the first such call restores the steady posture from the record, writes status not_run with a reason naming market_open_0055z and the 00:55Z open, exits 1; every later profile writes the same; tw_refresh_outcome_summary treats not_run as failing. Test: test_trading_day_before_market_open_restores_steady_once_and_marks_remaining_profiles_not_run, test_market_open_guard_window
acceptance_7_snapshot_reads_and_memory: each profile call waits for /readyz (36 x 5 s) before the preflight and reuses the bounded runtime without recreating it; preflight reads retry a warming-up source-ingest; memory.peak (docker exec cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak), HostConfig.Memory and State.OOMKilled are recorded in the state after every profile and before the restore and are reported by the steady check as bounded_runtime.memory_peak_bytes / memory_limit_bytes / oom_killed; an OOM-killed source-ingest fails the steady check (source_ingest_killed_for_memory). Tests: test_preflight_waits_for_a_warming_up_source_ingest_instead_of_failing_on_one_short_call, test_steady_check_fails_when_source_ingest_was_killed_for_memory

residual_findings: Why source-ingest needs about 31 s to stop is out of scope (market-data owner).
During the bounded window the steady scheduler and projector stay stopped for the whole run instead of per profile (the operator decision); collector steady pulls pause for the run duration.

If a run's first profile is interrupted while entering, the next profile enters again from the recorded steady state (one extra recreate, documented in test_interrupt_while_entering_is_retried_by_the_next_profile_and_still_restored_once).
Hosted recreate count and memory.peak of a real run are not yet observed: post-merge read of the next hosted run by the release owner.
